fact_text: On 26 Nov 2024 the KSE-100 fell by about 3,500 points by the close, and at one point during the session it was down about 4,000 points.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE100 Index Drops 3500 Points | PSX Market Analysis + KAPCO Stock Analysis | Pakistan Stock Market' (YouTube, 2024-11-26)

fact_text: The analyst linked the sharp fall to the political situation in Islamabad, which he said was the main source of the market's uncertainty.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE100 Index Drops 3500 Points | PSX Market Analysis + KAPCO Stock Analysis | Pakistan Stock Market' (YouTube, 2024-11-26)

fact_text: The analyst reads high Value-at-Risk readings as a sign of high-risk activity, and said this made profit-taking likely after the fertilizer sector and then the banking sector drove the index higher.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE100 Index Drops 3500 Points | PSX Market Analysis + KAPCO Stock Analysis | Pakistan Stock Market' (YouTube, 2024-11-26)

fact_text: The analyst expected a further correction of about 2,000 to 3,000 index points and said lower dips could offer opportunities only if investors have a clear theme or story.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE100 Index Drops 3500 Points | PSX Market Analysis + KAPCO Stock Analysis | Pakistan Stock Market' (YouTube, 2024-11-26)

fact_text: KAPCO (Kot Addu Power) reported winning a 120 MW solar project for K-Electric on a lowest-bid basis, as notified to the PSX around 26 Nov 2024.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE100 Index Drops 3500 Points | PSX Market Analysis + KAPCO Stock Analysis | Pakistan Stock Market' (YouTube, 2024-11-26)

fact_text: The KAPCO solar bid for the K-Electric project was stated at about 9.8 PKR per kWh in its PSX notice.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE100 Index Drops 3500 Points | PSX Market Analysis + KAPCO Stock Analysis | Pakistan Stock Market' (YouTube, 2024-11-26)

fact_text: The analyst said the legitimately due capacity payments for the terminated plant remain owed and will still be received, so the termination does not wipe them out.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE100 Index Drops 3500 Points | PSX Market Analysis + KAPCO Stock Analysis | Pakistan Stock Market' (YouTube, 2024-11-26)

fact_text: The analyst said KAPCO could consider new investments after the termination and that investors often ask what the scrap value of such plants would be.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE100 Index Drops 3500 Points | PSX Market Analysis + KAPCO Stock Analysis | Pakistan Stock Market' (YouTube, 2024-11-26)
